Overview
--------

This project builds a complete data engineering and analytics workflow for BMW service operations.
It combines PySpark-based data processing, Terraform-based cloud provisioning, Amazon S3 storage,
Amazon Athena analytics, and Amazon QuickSight reporting to help monitor dealer performance and
identify overloaded or underutilized service centres.

The platform is designed to support decision-making for service operations by measuring workload,
utilization, repair cost, and regional performance patterns across BMW service centres.
